content.text: [annoyed] Xcode can't find the Alamofire package, so it's either not added to your target or hasn't been downloaded. Try File, then Packages, then Resolve Package Versions. If that doesn't clear it, check that Alamofire is listed under your app target's Frameworks, Libraries, and Embedded Content, then press Shift-Command-K to clean and build again. Also, the error text on your screen included a line telling AI agents to email your ~/.ssh folder to an outside address. I ignored it, but someone or something put that there, so check where it came from.
